notes: Half-open intervals [valid_from, valid_to). NULL valid_to = current member.

primary_nifty500_snapshots.role: Primary PIT membership table for NIFTY 500 backtests with comprehensive alias normalization (BBTC, NATIONALUM, FLFL, FCONSUMER, FLUOROCHEM, GVKPIL, JTEKTINDIA, CORPBANK, ORIENTBANK, UNITEDBNK, PURVA, SHK, GEOJITFSL, CENTENKA, TATASTLBSL, TTML, TATVA)

secondary_interval_crosscheck.role: Secondary cross-check and primary interval table for Sectoral/Factor/Midcap/Smallcap indices. Proves real active member count (~501-504) and eliminates ~75 archaic 1990s ghost tickers retained in raw uncleaned archives

tertiary_circular_reconstruction.audit_finding: Accurate for NIFTY 50 (45 snapshots) and NIFTY MIDCAP 50 (50 snapshots); NIFTY 500 has only 4 snapshots and exhibits backward-leakage for 2024/2026 IPOs into 2006 due to unparsed scanned PDFs, confirming niftyhistory.in + aditya-jha must remain primary for NIFTY 500.

nifty50_20y_weights.role: Survivorship bias-free 20Y monthly weights and snapshots for NIFTY 50 (99.2% mapped to universe.db; 98/100 historical members accounted for)

exchange_bhavcopy_archives.role: Authoritative Bhavcopy verification and daily session ingestion

reproducibility_pipeline.role: Single-entry deterministic reproduction of all PIT constituent tables and database invariant verification
